title.en: The World Is a Small Village

intro.en: Huda asks her teacher about the computer, e-mail and the internet. Notice how the computer lets us send letters anywhere in the world.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein Huda apni ustaani se computer, e-mail aur internet ke baare mein poochhti hai. Dekhein ke computer se hum duniya mein kahin bhi khat bhej sakte hain.
intro.ar: هُدى تَسْأَلُ مُعَلِّمَتَها عَنِ الحاسوبِ وَالبَريدِ الإِلِكْتْرونِيِّ وَالشَّبَكَةِ الدَّوْلِيَّةِ. اِنْتَبِهْ كَيْفَ يَسْمَحُ الحاسوبُ بِإِرْسالِ الرَّسائِلِ إِلى أَيِّ مَكانٍ في العالَمِ.

dialogue.ar: يا مُعَلِّمَتي، لِماذا يَجْلِسُ أَخي أَمامَ الحاسوبِ أَطْوَلَ مِمّا كانَ يَجْلِسُ أَمامَ التِّلْفازِ؟
dialogue.tr: yā muʿallimatī, limādhā yajlisu akhī amāma l-ḥāsūbi aṭwala mimmā kāna yajlisu amāma t-tilfāz?
dialogue.en: Teacher, why does my brother sit in front of the computer longer than he used to sit in front of the TV?
dialogue.ur: Ustaani jaan, mera bhai computer ke saamne us se zyada kyun baithta hai jitna pehle television ke saamne baithta tha?

dialogue.ar: لِأَنَّ فَوائِدَ الحاسوبِ كَثيرَةٌ، وَهُوَ يَفْعَلُ ما لا يَفْعَلُهُ التِّلْفازُ.
dialogue.tr: liʾanna fawʾida l-ḥāsūbi kathīra, wahuwa yafʿalu mā lā yafʿaluhu t-tilfāz
dialogue.en: Because the benefits of the computer are many, and it does what the television does not do.
dialogue.ur: Kyunke computer ke faide bohat hain, aur wo wo kaam karta hai jo television nahin karta.

dialogue.ar: وَما هَذِهِ الأَوْراقُ الصَّغيرَةُ الَّتي تَظْهَرُ عَلى الشّاشَةِ؟
dialogue.tr: wamā hādhihi l-awrāqu ṣ-ṣaghīratu llatī taẓharu ʿalā sh-shāsha?
dialogue.en: And what are these small papers that appear on the screen?
dialogue.ur: Aur ye chhote chhote kaghaz kya hain jo screen par nazar aate hain?

dialogue.ar: هَذِهِ رَسائِلُ جاءَتْنا عَبْرَ البَريدِ الإِلِكْتْرونِيِّ مُنْذُ قَليلٍ.
dialogue.tr: hādhihi rasāʾilu jāʾatnā ʿabra l-barīdi l-iliktrūniyyi mundhu qalīl
dialogue.en: These are messages that came to us through e-mail a little while ago.
dialogue.ur: Ye wo khutoot hain jo thori der pehle e-mail ke zariye aaye hain.

dialogue.ar: وَمِنْ أَيْنَ تَأْتي هَذِهِ الرَّسائِلُ؟
dialogue.tr: wamin ayna taʾtī hādhihi r-rasāʾil?
dialogue.en: And where do these messages come from?
dialogue.ur: Aur ye khutoot kahan se aate hain?

dialogue.ar: أَحْفَظُ عَناوينَ صَديقاتي في الحاسوبِ، وَأَبْعَثُ إِلَيْهِنَّ رَسائِلي إِلى أَيِّ بَلَدٍ في العالَمِ.
dialogue.tr: aḥfaẓu ʿanāwīna ṣadīqātī fī l-ḥāsūb, waʾabʿathu ilayhinna rasāʾilī ilā ayyi baladin fī l-ʿālam
dialogue.en: I keep my friends' addresses in the computer, and I send my messages to them in any country in the world.
dialogue.ur: Main apni saheliyon ke pate computer mein rakhti hoon, aur duniya ke kisi bhi mulk mein unhein apne khat bhejti hoon.

dialogue.ar: هَذا شَيْءٌ عَجيبٌ يا مُعَلِّمَتي!
dialogue.tr: hādhā shayʾun ʿajībun yā muʿallimatī
dialogue.en: This is something amazing, teacher!
dialogue.ur: Ustaani jaan, ye to ajeeb cheez hai!

dialogue.ar: وَما هِيَ الشَّبَكَةُ الدَّوْلِيَّةُ الَّتي يَتَحَدَّثُ عَنْها أَخي؟
dialogue.tr: wamā hiya sh-shabakatu d-dawliyatu llatī yataḥaddathu ʿanhā akhī?
dialogue.en: And what is the international network that my brother talks about?
dialogue.ur: Aur wo beinul-aqwami network kya hai jis ke baare mein mera bhai baat karta hai?

dialogue.ar: هِيَ شَبَكَةٌ تَرْبِطُ مَلايينَ الحَواسيبِ في العالَمِ بِخُطوطِ الاتِّصالِ.
dialogue.tr: hiya shabakatun tarbiṭu malāīīna l-ḥawsībi fī l-ʿālami bikhuṭūṭi l-ttiṣāl
dialogue.en: It is a network that links millions of computers in the world through communication lines.
dialogue.ur: Ye ek network hai jo duniya ke karoron computers ko rabte ki lakeeron se jodta hai.

dialogue.ar: وَماذا نَسْتَفيدُ مِنْها؟
dialogue.tr: wamādhā nastafīdu minhā?
dialogue.en: And what do we benefit from it?
dialogue.ur: Aur hum us se kya faida uthate hain?

dialogue.ar: نَسْتَفيدُ كَثيراً: تَجِدينَ فيها عَناوينَ المَكْتَباتِ وَمَراكِزِ البُحوثِ وَالجامِعاتِ، وَتَحْصُلينَ عَلى المَعْلوماتِ وَأَنْتِ جالِسَةٌ في بَيْتِكِ.
dialogue.tr: nastafīdu kathīran tajidīna fīhā ʿanāwīna l-maktabāti wamarākizi l-buḥūthi wal-jāmiʿāt, wataḥṣulīna ʿalā l-maʿlūmāti waʾanti jālisatun fī baytik
dialogue.en: We benefit a lot: you find in it the addresses of libraries, research centres and universities, and you get information while sitting in your home.
dialogue.ur: Hum bohat faida uthate hain: us mein aapko library, research centre aur jamiaat ke pate milte hain, aur aap ghar baithe maloomat hasil kar sakti hain.

dialogue.ar: ما أَعْجَبَ هَذا الأَمْرَ!
dialogue.tr: mā aʿjaba hādhā l-amr
dialogue.en: How amazing this matter is!
dialogue.ur: Ye baat kitni ajeeb hai!

q.en: Why does Huda's brother spend more time at the computer?
q.ur: Huda ka bhai computer ke saamne zyada waqt kyun guzarta hai?
q.ar: لِماذا يَقْضي أَخو هُدى وَقْتاً أَطْوَلَ أَمامَ الحاسوبِ؟

options: It is cheaper than a TV

q.en: What does the international network link?
q.ur: Internet kis cheez ko aapas mein jorta hai?

title.en: Sounds: the Lam in the name Allah

intro.en: The letter lam in «الله» is sometimes light (مُرَقَّقَة) and sometimes heavy (مُفَخَّمَة). It is light when the word before it ends with a kasra; otherwise it is heavy. Listen and repeat the examples.
intro.ur: Lafz «الله» ka laam kabhi halka (مُرَقَّقَة) aur kabhi bhaari (مُفَخَّمَة) parha jata hai. Agar us se pehle kasra ho to halka, warna bhaari. Misalon ko sunein aur dohrayein.
intro.ar: لامُ لَفْظِ الجَلالَةِ «الله» تَكونُ أَحْياناً مُرَقَّقَةً وَأَحْياناً مُفَخَّمَةً. تُرَقَّقُ إِذا سَبَقَتْها كَسْرَةٌ، وَتُفَخَّمُ في غَيْرِ ذَلِكَ. اِسْتَمِعْ وَكَرِّرِ الأَمْثِلَةَ.

dialogue.ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ.
dialogue.tr: bismi llāhi r-raḥmāni r-raḥīm
dialogue.en: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. (light lam, after a kasra)
dialogue.ur: Allah ke naam se, jo bahut meherban, nihayat raham karne wala hai. (kasra ke baad halka laam)

dialogue.ar: وَاللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ.
dialogue.tr: wallāhu ghafūrun raḥīm
dialogue.en: And Allah is Forgiving and Merciful. (heavy lam)
dialogue.ur: Aur Allah bakhshne wala, raham karne wala hai. (bhaari laam)

dialogue.ar: ما شاءَ اللهُ.
dialogue.tr: mā shāʾa llāh
dialogue.en: What Allah has willed.
dialogue.ur: Jo Allah ne chaha.

dialogue.ar: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ.
dialogue.tr: al-ḥamdu lillāh rabbi al-ʿālamīn
dialogue.en: Praise be to Allah, Lord of the worlds. (light lam, after a kasra)
dialogue.ur: Tamam tareefein Allah ke liye hain jo saare jahanon ka Rab hai. (patla laam, kasra ke baad)

dialogue.ar: بارَكَ اللهُ فيكَ.
dialogue.tr: bāraka llāh fīk
dialogue.en: May Allah bless you. (heavy lam)
dialogue.ur: Allah tumhein barkat de. (moti laam)

q.en: When is the lam in «الله» light (مُرَقَّقَة)?
q.ur: «الله» ka laam kab halka (مُرَقَّقَة) hota hai?
q.ar: مَتى تُرَقَّقُ اللّامُ في لَفْظِ الجَلالَةِ «الله»؟

options: When a kasra comes before it
When a fatha comes before it
When a damma comes before it

title.en: Grammar: the form of the command verb

intro.en: The command verb (فِعْلُ الأَمْرِ) never changes its ending the way nouns do; it is fixed (مَبْنِيّ). It ends in sukun or fatha, or it drops the weak letter or the noon. Example: «اِرْكَبْ» (ride!) for a man, «اِرْكَبي» for a woman.
intro.ur: Fe'l-e-amr (hukm ka fe'l) ka aakhir badalta nahin, woh mabni (tay-shuda) rehta hai. Woh sukoon ya fatha par khatam hota hai, ya harf-e-illat ya noon gira diya jata hai. Misal: «اِرْكَبْ» (sawaar ho) mard ke liye, «اِرْكَبي» aurat ke liye.
intro.ar: فِعْلُ الأَمْرِ مَبْنِيٌّ لا يَتَغَيَّرُ آخِرُهُ كَالأَسْماءِ: يُبْنى عَلى السُّكونِ أَوِ الفَتْحِ أَوْ حَذْفِ حَرْفِ العِلَّةِ أَوِ النّونِ. مِثالٌ: اِرْكَبْ لِلرَّجُلِ، وَاِرْكَبي لِلْمَرْأَةِ.

options_ar: مُعْرَبٌ يَتَغَيَّرُ آخِرُهُ في كُلِّ جُمْلَةٍ

q.en: Which is the command for a group of men?
q.ur: Mardon ki jama'at ke liye hukm kaun sa hai?
q.ar: ما فِعْلُ الأَمْرِ المُوَجَّهُ إِلى جَماعَةِ الرِّجالِ؟

title.en: Listening and speaking: TV and computer

intro.en: Listen to a conversation about daily life today, then answer questions. Then practise asking a classmate about TV and the computer.
intro.ur: Aaj ki zindagi ke baare mein ek guftagu sunein aur sawalon ke jawab dein. Phir apne saathi se TV aur computer ke baare mein sawal poochhein.
intro.ar: اِسْتَمِعْ إِلى حِوارٍ عَنِ الحَياةِ اليَوْمِيَّةِ في هَذا العَصْرِ ثُمَّ أَجِبْ عَنِ الأَسْئِلَةِ. بَعْدَها اِسْأَلْ زَميلَكَ عَنِ التِّلْفازِ وَالحاسوبِ.

dialogue.ar: هَلْ عِنْدَكَ تِلْفازٌ في بَيْتِكَ؟
dialogue.tr: hal ʿindaka tilfāzun fī baytik?
dialogue.en: Do you have a television in your house?
dialogue.ur: Kya aap ke ghar mein television hai?

dialogue.ar: ما عَدَدُ السّاعاتِ الَّتي تَجْلِسُ فيها أَمامَ الشّاشَةِ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ؟
dialogue.tr: mā ʿadadu s-sāʿāti llatī tajlisu fīhā amāma sh-shāshati kulla yawm?
dialogue.en: How many hours do you sit in front of the screen each day?
dialogue.ur: Aap din mein kitne ghante screen ke saamne baithte hain?

dialogue.ar: أَيَّ بَرامِجَ تُشاهِدُ؟
dialogue.tr: ayya barāmija tushāhid?
dialogue.en: Which programmes do you watch?
dialogue.ur: Aap kaun se programme dekhte hain?

dialogue.ar: وَهَلْ لَدَيْكَ حاسوبٌ أَيْضاً؟
dialogue.tr: wahal ladayka ḥāsūbun ayḍan?
dialogue.en: And do you have a computer too?
dialogue.ur: Aur kya aap ke paas computer bhi hai?

dialogue.ar: وَلِماذا تَسْتَخْدِمُهُ؟ لِلدِّراسَةِ أَمْ لِلَّعِبِ؟
dialogue.tr: walimādhā tastakhdimuh? lid-dirāsati am lillaʿib?
dialogue.en: And why do you use it? For study or for play?
dialogue.ur: Aur aap use kyun istemal karte hain? Parhai ke liye ya khel ke liye?

dialogue.ar: أَيُّهُما أَفْضَلُ لِلدِّراسَةِ بِرَأْيِكَ: الحاسوبُ أَمِ التِّلْفازُ؟ اِشْرَحْ سَبَبَكَ.
dialogue.tr: ayyuhumā afḍalu lid-dirāsati biraʾyik al-ḥāsūbu ami t-tilfāz? ishraḥ sababak
dialogue.en: Which is better for studying in your opinion: the computer or the TV? Explain your reason.
dialogue.ur: Aapki raye mein parhai ke liye behtar kaun sa hai: computer ya television? Apni wajah batayein.

q.en: How do you ask «Do you have a computer?»
q.ur: «Kya aap ke paas computer hai?» kaise poochenge?
q.ar: كَيْفَ تَسْأَلُ صَديقَكَ إِنْ كانَ عِنْدَهُ حاسوبٌ؟

title.en: Transport and communication, old and new
title.ur: Naql o hamal aur rabte ke zaraye: purane aur naye

intro.en: A reading passage about why the world has become a small village: modern transport and modern communication. It compares old camels and doves with cars, planes, the telephone and the internet.
intro.ur: Is paaray mein bataya gaya hai ke duniya chhota gaon kyun ban gayi: jadeed sawari aur jadeed rabte ke zaraye. Purane unt aur kabootar ka muqabla car, jahaz, telephone aur internet se kiya gaya hai.
intro.ar: نَصٌّ عَنْ سَبَبِ تَحَوُّلِ العالَمِ إِلى قَرْيَةٍ صَغيرَةٍ: وَسائِلُ النَّقْلِ الحَديثَةُ وَوَسائِلُ الاتِّصالِ الحَديثَةُ. يُقارِنُ النَّصُّ بَيْنَ الجِمالِ وَالحَمامِ قَديماً وَالسَّيّاراتِ وَالطّائِراتِ وَالهاتِفِ وَالإِنْتَرْنِتِ حَديثاً.

dialogue.ar: عَدَدُ القارّاتِ في الأَرْضِ سَبْعٌ، وَيَسْكُنُها اليَوْمَ أَكْثَرُ مِنْ سَبْعَةِ مِلْياراتِ إِنْسانٍ.
dialogue.tr: ʿadadu l-qārrāti fī l-arḍi sabʿ, wayaskunuhā l-yawma aktharu min sabʿati milyrāti insān
dialogue.en: There are seven continents on earth, and more than seven billion people live on it today.
dialogue.ur: Zameen par saat barr-e-azam hain, aur aaj us par saat arab se zyada insaan rehte hain.

dialogue.ar: وَمَعَ ذَلِكَ يَقولُ النّاسُ اليَوْمَ: إِنَّ العالَمَ صارَ قَرْيَةً صَغيرَةً. فَما السَّبَبُ؟
dialogue.tr: wamaʿa dhālika yaqūlu n-nāsu l-yawm inna al-ʿālama ṣāra qaryatan ṣaghīra famā s-sabab?
dialogue.en: Even so, people say today: the world has become a small village. So what is the reason?
dialogue.ur: Phir bhi log aaj kehte hain: duniya ek chhota sa gaon ban gayi hai. Is ki wajah kya hai?

dialogue.ar: السَّبَبُ شَيْئانِ: تَطَوُّرُ وَسائِلِ النَّقْلِ، وَتَطَوُّرُ وَسائِلِ الاتِّصالِ.
dialogue.tr: as-sababu shayʾān taṭawwuru wasāʾili n-naql, wataṭawwuru wasāʾili l-ttiṣāl
dialogue.en: The reason is two things: the development of means of transport and the development of means of communication.
dialogue.ur: Wajah do cheezein hain: naql o hamal ke zaraye ki taraqqi aur rabte ke zaraye ki taraqqi.

dialogue.ar: في العُصورِ القَديمَةِ كانَ السَّفَرُ بَطيئاً وَمُتْعِباً، وَكانَ المُسافِرُ يَقْطَعُ المَسافاتِ الطَّويلَةَ سَيْراً عَلى قَدَمَيْهِ.
dialogue.tr: fī l-ʿuṣūri l-qadīmati kāna s-safaru baṭīʾan wamutʿiban, wakāna l-musāfiru yaqṭaʿu l-masāfāti ṭ-ṭawīlata sayran ʿalā qadamayh
dialogue.en: In ancient times travel was slow and tiring, and the traveller covered long distances walking on his feet.
dialogue.ur: Qadeem zamane mein safar sust aur thaka dene wala tha, aur musafir lambe faasle paidal tay karta tha.

dialogue.ar: وَبَعْدَ ذَلِكَ اسْتَعانَ الإِنْسانُ بِالجِمالِ وَالبِغالِ وَالحَميرِ لِيَحْمِلَ أَمْتِعَتَهُ وَيَنْتَقِلَ بِها.
dialogue.tr: wabaʿda dhālika staʿāna l-insānu bil-jimāli wal-bighāli wal-ḥamīri liyaḥmila amtiʿatahu wayantaqila bihā
dialogue.en: After that man used camels, mules and donkeys to carry his belongings and travel with them.
dialogue.ur: Phir insaan ne oonton, khachcharon aur gadhon ki madad li taake apna saman utha kar un par safar kare.

dialogue.ar: ثُمَّ جاءَتِ السُّفُنُ الشِّراعِيَّةُ تَسيرُ في البِحارِ بِقُوَّةِ الرِّياحِ، وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَها مُحَرِّكٌ.
dialogue.tr: thumma jāʾati s-sufunu sh-shirāʿiyatu tasīru fī l-biḥāri biquwwati r-rīḥ, walam yakun lahā muḥarrik
dialogue.en: Then came sailing ships that moved over the seas with the power of the wind, and they had no engine.
dialogue.ur: Phir baadbani kashtiyan aayin jo hawaon ki taqat se samundron mein chalti thin, aur unka koi engine nahin tha.

dialogue.ar: وَفي العَصْرِ الحَديثِ اخْتَرَعَ الإِنْسانُ المُحَرِّكَ، فَظَهَرَتِ السَّيّارَةُ وَالقِطارُ وَالسَّفينَةُ الكَبيرَةُ وَالطّائِرَةُ.
dialogue.tr: wafī l-ʿaṣri l-ḥadīthi khtaraʿa l-insānu l-muḥarrik, faẓaharati s-sayāratu wal-qiṭāru was-safīnatu l-kabīratu waṭ-ṭāʾira
dialogue.en: In modern times man invented the engine, and the car, the train, the large ship and the plane appeared.
dialogue.ur: Jadeed daur mein insaan ne engine ijad kiya, to car, train, bara jahaz aur hawai jahaz saamne aaye.

dialogue.ar: فَصارَ المُسافِرُ يَصِلُ في ساعاتٍ قَليلَةٍ إِلى بَلَدٍ بَعيدٍ، بَلْ إِلى قارَّةٍ أُخْرى.
dialogue.tr: faṣāra l-musāfiru yaṣilu fī sāʿātin qalīlatin ilā baladin baʿīd, bal ilā qārratin ukhrā
dialogue.en: So the traveller began to reach a distant country in a few hours, even another continent.
dialogue.ur: To musafir chand ghanton mein door ke mulk, balkay doosre barr-e-azam tak pahunchne laga.

dialogue.ar: وَالسَّبَبُ الآخَرُ هُوَ وَسائِلُ الاتِّصالِ: الصُّحُفُ وَالهاتِفُ وَالإِذاعَةُ وَالتِّلْفازُ وَالحاسوبُ، فَبِها تَنْتَقِلُ الأَخْبارُ في لَحْظَةٍ.
dialogue.tr: was-sababu l-ʾākharu huwa wasāʾilu l-ttiṣāl aṣ-ṣuḥufu wal-hātifu wal-idhāʿatu wat-tilfāzu wal-ḥāsūb, fabihā tantaqilu l-akhbāru fī laḥẓa
dialogue.en: The other reason is the means of communication: newspapers, the telephone, the radio, television and the computer, through which news travels in a moment.
dialogue.ur: Doosri wajah rabte ke zaraye hain: akhbarat, telephone, radio, television aur computer, jin ke zariye khabrein ek lamhe mein pahunch jati hain.

dialogue.ar: أَمّا قَديماً فَكانَتِ الأَخْبارُ تَحْتاجُ إِلى أَيّامٍ أَوْ شُهورٍ حَتّى تَصِلَ، وَرُبَّما لا تَصِلُ أَبَداً.
dialogue.tr: ammā qadīman fakānati l-akhbāru taḥtāju ilā ayyāmin aw shuhūrin ḥattā taṣil, warubbamā lā taṣilu abadan
dialogue.en: In the past, news needed days or months to arrive, and perhaps it never arrived at all.
dialogue.ur: Pehle khabron ko pahunchne mein din ya mahine lagte the, aur shayad kabhi pahunchti hi nahin thin.

q.en: How many continents does the passage say the earth is divided into?
q.ur: Matn ke mutabiq zameen kitne barr-e-azamon mein bantti hai?
q.ar: إِلى كَمْ قارَّةٍ تَنْقَسِمُ الأَرْضُ بِحَسَبِ النَّصِّ؟

q.en: What are the two reasons the world became a small village?
q.ur: Duniya ke chhota gaon banne ki do wajahein kya hain?
q.ar: ما سَبَبا تَحَوُّلِ العالَمِ إِلى قَرْيَةٍ صَغيرَةٍ؟

options_ar: وَسائِلُ النَّقْلِ الحَديثَةُ وَوَسائِلُ الاتِّصالِ الحَديثَةُ

q.en: Which one is an animal used for carrying in old times?
q.ur: Purane zamane mein saman uthane wala janwar kaun sa hai?
q.ar: أَيٌّ مِمّا يَأْتي حَيَوانٌ كانَ يُسْتَعْمَلُ لِلنَّقْلِ قَديماً؟

options_ar: جِهازٌ نَتَكَلَّمُ بِهِ مَعَ مَنْ يَبْعُدُ عَنّا

title.en: Grammar: the form of the past verb

intro.en: The past verb is also fixed (مَبْنِيّ). It ends in damma when «واو الجماعة» is added (فَتَحوا), in sukun when «تاء الفاعل», «نا» or «نون النسوة» is added (سَمِعْتُ), and in fatha in all other cases (رَكِبَ).
intro.ur: Fe'l-e-maazi bhi mabni hota hai. Agar «waaw-e-jama'at» lage to damma par (فَتَحوا), agar «taa-e-faa'il», «naa» ya «noon-e-niswa» lage to sukoon par (سَمِعْتُ), aur baaqi sab surtoon mein fatha par (رَكِبَ) mabni hota hai.
intro.ar: الفِعْلُ الماضي مَبْنِيٌّ أَيْضاً: يُبْنى عَلى الضَّمِّ مَعَ واوِ الجَماعَةِ (فَتَحوا)، وَعَلى السُّكونِ مَعَ تاءِ الفاعِلِ أَوْ «نا» أَوْ نونِ النِّسْوَةِ (سَمِعْتُ)، وَعَلى الفَتْحِ في غَيْرِ ذَلِكَ (رَكِبَ).

dialogue.ar: فَتَحوا البابَ.
dialogue.tr: fataḥū l-bāb
dialogue.en: They opened the door. (ends in damma: waw of the group)
dialogue.ur: Unhon ne darwaza khola. (damma par khatam: waw-e-jama'at)

dialogue.ar: سَمِعْتُ الإِذاعَةَ.
dialogue.tr: samiʿtu l-idhāʿa
dialogue.en: I listened to the radio. (ends in sukun: ta of the doer)
dialogue.ur: Maine radio suna. (sukoon par khatam: taa-e-faa'il)

dialogue.ar: فَهِمْنا الدَّرْسَ.
dialogue.tr: fahimnā d-dars
dialogue.en: We understood the lesson. (ends in sukun: «naa»)
dialogue.ur: Hum ne sabaq samjha. (sukoon par khatam: «naa»)

dialogue.ar: الطّالِباتُ سافَرْنَ إِلى القاهِرَةِ.
dialogue.tr: aṭ-ṭālibātu sāfarna ilā l-qāhira
dialogue.en: The students (f.) travelled to Cairo. (ends in sukun: noon of women)
dialogue.ur: Talibaat Qahira gayin. (sukoon par khatam: noon-e-niswa)

dialogue.ar: رَكِبَ الوَلَدُ القِطارَ.
dialogue.tr: rakiba l-waladu l-qiṭār
dialogue.en: The boy rode the train. (ends in fatha)
dialogue.ur: Ladke ne train mein safar kiya. (fatha par khatam)

dialogue.ar: شَرِبا الماءَ.
dialogue.tr: sharibā l-māʾ
dialogue.en: They (two) drank water. (fatha: alif of the two)
dialogue.ur: Un dono ne paani piya. (fatha: alif-e-tasniya)

q.en: The past verb «سَمِعْتُ» ends in sukun because of:
q.ur: Fe'l-e-maazi «سَمِعْتُ» sukoon par kyun khatam hota hai?
Kaun sa fe'l fatha par khatam hota hai?

intro.en: Rana and Suad talk about a symposium on globalization that Suad missed. One group supported it and one group rejected it. Notice how each side gives its reasons.
intro.ur: Rana aur Suad aalmgiriyat (globalization) par ek seminar ke baare mein baat karti hain jo Suad se reh gaya. Ek giroh isse chahta tha aur doosra rad karta tha. Dekhein har taraf apni daleel kaise deti hai.
intro.ar: رَنا وَسُعادُ تَتَحَدَّثانِ عَنْ نَدْوَةٍ عَنِ العَوْلَمَةِ فاتَتْ سُعادَ؛ فَريقٌ أَيَّدَها وَفَريقٌ رَفَضَها. اِنْتَبِهْ كَيْفَ يَذْكُرُ كُلُّ فَريقٍ أَسْبابَهُ.

dialogue.ar: لَقَدْ فاتَتْكِ أَمْسِ نَدْوَةٌ مُهِمَّةٌ في النّادي الثَّقافِيِّ يا سُعادُ.
dialogue.tr: laqad fātatki amsi nadwatun muhimmatun fī n-nādī th-thaqāfiyi yā suʿād
dialogue.en: You missed an important symposium yesterday at the cultural club, Suad.
dialogue.ur: Suad, kal culture club mein ek ahem seminar tha jo aapse reh gaya.

dialogue.ar: أَعْتَذِرُ يا رَنا، كُنْتُ مَشْغولَةً بِضُيوفٍ جاؤوا إِلى بَيْتِنا.
dialogue.tr: aʿtadhiru yā ranā, kuntu mashghūlatan biḍuywfin jāʾū ilā baytinā
dialogue.en: I am sorry, Rana, I was busy with guests who came to our house.
dialogue.ur: Maafi chahti hoon Rana, main un mehmanon mein masroof thi jo hamare ghar aaye the.

dialogue.ar: كانَ الحُضورُ كَبيراً؛ فَقَدْ جاءَ مُعْظَمُ طُلّابِ الكُلِّيَّةِ.
dialogue.tr: kāna l-ḥuḍūru kabīran faqad jāʾa muʿẓamu ṭullābi l-kulliyya
dialogue.en: The audience was large; most of the college students came.
dialogue.ur: Hazireen bohat the; college ke zyadatar talba aaye the.

dialogue.ar: وَعَنْ أَيِّ مَوْضوعٍ تَحَدَّثوا؟
dialogue.tr: waʿan ayyi mawḍūʿin taḥaddathū?
dialogue.en: And what topic did they talk about?
dialogue.ur: Aur unhon ne kis mauzu par baat ki?

dialogue.ar: عَنِ العَوْلَمَةِ، وَانْقَسَمَ المُتَحَدِّثونَ فَريقَيْنِ: فَريقٌ مَعَها وَفَريقٌ ضِدَّها.
dialogue.tr: ʿani l-ʿawlama, wānqasama l-mutaḥaddithūna farīqayn farīqun maʿahā wafarīqun ḍiddahā
dialogue.en: About globalization, and the speakers split into two groups: one group for it and one group against it.
dialogue.ur: Aalmgiriyat par, aur muqarrireen do giroho mein bat gaye: ek uske haq mein aur ek uske khilaf.

dialogue.ar: وَما حُجَجُ الفَريقَيْنِ؟
dialogue.tr: wamā ḥujaju l-farīqayn?
dialogue.en: And what are the arguments of the two groups?
dialogue.ur: Aur dono giroho ki daleelein kya thin?

dialogue.ar: يَرى المُؤَيِّدونَ أَنَّ العَوْلَمَةَ تُقَرِّبُ بَيْنَ الشُّعوبِ، وَتَبْدَأُ بِها تَنْمِيَةُ الدُّوَلِ الفَقيرَةِ.
dialogue.tr: yarā l-muʾayyidūna anna al-ʿawlamata tuqarribu bayna sh-shuʿūb, watabdaʾu bihā tanmiyatu d-duwali l-faqīra
dialogue.en: The supporters see that globalization brings peoples closer, and the development of the poor countries begins with it.
dialogue.ur: Himayat karne wale samajhte hain ke aalmgiriyat qaumon ko qareeb laati hai, aur ghareeb mulkon ki taraqqi usi se shuru hoti hai.

dialogue.ar: وَماذا قالَ الآخَرونَ؟
dialogue.tr: wamādhā qāla l-ʾākharūn?
dialogue.en: And what did the others say?
dialogue.ur: Aur doosron ne kya kaha?

dialogue.ar: قالوا: تُعْطي العَوْلَمَةُ الدُّوَلَ الغَنِيَّةَ هَيْمَنَةً عَلى الدُّوَلِ الفَقيرَةِ في الاقْتِصادِ وَغَيْرِهِ.
dialogue.tr: qālū tuʿṭī l-ʿawlamatu d-duwala l-ghaniyyata haymanatan ʿalā d-duwali l-faqīrati fī l-qtiṣādi waghayrih
dialogue.en: They said: globalization gives the rich countries domination over the poor countries in the economy and more.
dialogue.ur: Unhon ne kaha: aalmgiriyat amir mulkon ko maeeshat aur doosre maidanon mein ghareeb mulkon par ghalba de deti hai.

dialogue.ar: وَكَيْفَ كانَتْ نِهايَةُ اللِّقاءِ؟
dialogue.tr: wakayfa kānat nihāyatu l-liqāʾ?
dialogue.en: And how did the meeting end?
dialogue.ur: Aur is nashist ka ikhtitam kaise hua?

dialogue.ar: اِنْتَهى اللِّقاءُ بِنِقاشٍ طَويلٍ، ثُمَّ رَفَضَ مُعْظَمُ الحُضورِ فِكْرَةَ العَوْلَمَةِ.
dialogue.tr: intahā l-liqāʾu biniqāshin ṭawīl, thumma rafaḍa muʿẓamu l-ḥuḍūri fikrata l-ʿawlama
dialogue.en: The meeting ended with a long discussion, and then most of the audience rejected the idea of globalization.
dialogue.ur: Nashist lambi behes par khatam hui, phir zyadatar hazireen ne aalmgiriyat ke khayal ko rad kar diya.

dialogue.ar: وَلِماذا رَفَضوها؟
dialogue.tr: walimādhā rafaḍūhā?
dialogue.en: And why did they reject it?
dialogue.ur: Aur unhon ne use kyun rad kiya?

dialogue.ar: خافوا أَنْ تَفْرِضَ الدُّوَلُ القَوِيَّةُ ثَقافَتَها وَلُغَتَها عَلى الشُّعوبِ الضَّعيفَةِ.
dialogue.tr: khāfū an tafriḍa d-duwalu l-qawiyyatu thaqāfatahā walughatahā ʿalā sh-shuʿūbi ḍ-ḍaʿīfa
dialogue.en: They feared that strong countries would impose their culture and language on weak peoples.
dialogue.ur: Unhein dar tha ke taqatwar mulk apni saqafat aur zubaan kamzor qaumon par thop denge.

dialogue.ar: صَدَقوا؛ فَأَنا أُحِبُّ العالَمَ كُلَّهُ، لَكِنْ لا أُريدُ أَنْ أَفْقِدَ لُغَتي.
dialogue.tr: ṣadaqū faʾanā uḥibbu al-ʿālama kullah, lākin lā urīdu an afqida lughatī
dialogue.en: They were right; I love the whole world, but I do not want to lose my language.
dialogue.ur: Unhon ne theek kaha; mujhe saari duniya pasand hai, lekin main apni zubaan kho dena nahin chahti.

dialogue.ar: وَأَنا مِثْلُكِ، سَأَبْقى مُتَمَسِّكَةً بِلُغَتي وَثَقافَتي بِإِذْنِ اللهِ.
dialogue.tr: waʾanā mithluk, saʾabqā mutamassikatan bilughatī wathaqāfatī biʾidhni llāh
dialogue.en: And I am like you; I will stay attached to my language and my culture, by Allah's leave.
dialogue.ur: Main bhi aap jaisi hoon, Allah ke izn se main apni zubaan aur saqafat se juri rahungi.

q.ur: Suad seminar mein kyun nahin aayi?

q.en: What does the second group fear?
q.ur: Doosra giroh kis baat se darta hai?

options: Rich countries will dominate poor countries
options_ar: أَنْ تَسيطِرَ الدُّوَلُ الغَنِيَّةُ عَلى الدُّوَلِ الفَقيرَةِ
ما تَتَميَّزُ بِهِ الأُمَّةُ مِنْ عاداتٍ وَعُلومٍ وَفُنونٍ

q.en: What does Rana say at the end?
q.ur: Rana aakhir mein kya kehti hai?

options: She will stay attached to her language and culture
She will skip the next symposium

intro.en: Words change their last vowel according to their job in the sentence. The main marks are damma, fatha, kasra and sukun. Nouns take damma, fatha or kasra. Verbs take damma, fatha or sukun. Example: «الطِّفْلُ، الطِّفْلَ، الطِّفْلِ» and «يَجْلِسُ، لَنْ يَجْلِسَ، لَمْ يَجْلِسْ».
intro.ur: Alfaaz jumle mein apne kaam ke mutabiq aakhri harkat badalte hain. Asli alamaat hain: damma, fatha, kasra aur sukoon. Ism par damma, fatha ya kasra aata hai. Fe'l par damma, fatha ya sukoon. Misal: «الطِّفْلُ، الطِّفْلَ، الطِّفْلِ» aur «يَجْلِسُ، لَنْ يَجْلِسَ، لَمْ يَجْلِسْ».
intro.ar: تَتَغَيَّرُ حَرَكَةُ آخِرِ الكَلِمَةِ بِحَسَبِ مَوْقِعِها في الجُمْلَةِ. عَلاماتُ الإِعْرابِ الأَصْلِيَّةُ: الضَّمَّةُ وَالفَتْحَةُ وَالكَسْرَةُ وَالسُّكونُ. الاسْمُ يَأْخُذُ الضَّمَّةَ أَوِ الفَتْحَةَ أَوِ الكَسْرَةَ، وَالمُضارِعُ الضَّمَّةَ أَوِ الفَتْحَةَ أَوِ السُّكونَ. مِثالٌ: الطِّفْلُ، الطِّفْلَ، الطِّفْلِ، وَيَجْلِسُ، لَنْ يَجْلِسَ، لَمْ يَجْلِسْ.

q.en: Which four marks are the main case endings?
q.ur: Chaar asli alamaat kaun si hain?

q.en: In «لَمْ يَجْلِسْ» the verb ends in:
In «لَنْ يَجْلِسَ» the verb ends in:

title.en: Listening and speaking: one language, one culture?
title.ur: Sun kar samajhna aur guftagu: ek zubaan, ek saqafat?

intro.en: Listen to the dialogue about the book symposium and answer the questions. Then discuss with classmates whether the world should have one language, one culture, one economy and one politics.
intro.ur: Kitab ke seminar ki guftagu sunein aur sawalon ke jawab dein. Phir saathiyon se behes karein ke kya duniya ki ek zubaan, ek saqafat, ek maeeshat aur ek siyasat honi chahiye.
intro.ar: اِسْتَمِعْ إِلى الحِوارِ عَنْ نَدْوَةِ الكِتابِ وَأَجِبْ عَنِ الأَسْئِلَةِ. ثُمَّ ناقِشْ زُمَلاءَكَ: هَلْ يَنْبَغي أَنْ يَكونَ لِلْعالَمِ لُغَةٌ واحِدَةٌ وَثَقافَةٌ واحِدَةٌ وَاقْتِصادٌ واحِدٌ وَسِياسَةٌ واحِدَةٌ؟

dialogue.ar: في أَيِّ جُزْءٍ مِنَ العالَمِ تَسْكُنُ؟
dialogue.tr: fī ayyi juzʾin mina l-ʿālami taskun?
dialogue.en: In which part of the world do you live?
dialogue.ur: Aap duniya ke kis hisse mein rehte hain?

dialogue.ar: أَيُّ الدُّوَلِ أَغْنى في نَظَرِكَ، وَأَيُّها أَفْقَرُ؟
dialogue.tr: ayyu ad-duwali aghnā fī naẓarik, waʾayyuhā afqar?
dialogue.en: In your view, which countries are the richest, and which are the poorest?
dialogue.ur: Aapki nazar mein kaun se mulk sab se amir aur kaun se sab se ghareeb hain?

dialogue.ar: لَوْ كانَ لِلنّاسِ جَميعاً لُغَةٌ واحِدَةٌ، هَلْ تُوافِقُ عَلى ذَلِكَ؟ وَلِماذا؟
dialogue.tr: law kāna lin-nāsi jamīʿan lughatun wāḥida, hal tūfiqu ʿalā dhālika? walimādhā?
dialogue.en: If all people had one language, would you agree to that? And why?
dialogue.ur: Agar sab logon ki ek hi zubaan ho, to kya aap is par razi hain? Aur kyun?

dialogue.ar: هَلْ تُوافِقُ عَلى أَنْ تَتْرُكَ ثَقافَتَكَ مِنْ أَجْلِ ثَقافَةٍ أُخْرى؟ لِماذا؟
dialogue.tr: hal tūfiqu ʿalā an tatruka thaqāfataka min ajli thaqāfatin ukhrā? limādhā?
dialogue.en: Do you agree to leave your culture for the sake of another culture? Why?
dialogue.ur: Kya aap kisi doosri saqafat ki khatir apni saqafat chhodne par razi hain? Kyun?

dialogue.ar: هَلْ تَرى أَنَّ الأَفْضَلَ لِلْعالَمِ اقْتِصاداً واحِداً وَسِياسَةً واحِدَةً؟ ناقِشْ ذَلِكَ مَعَ زُمَلائِكَ.
dialogue.tr: hal tarā anna al-afḍala lil-ʿālami qtiṣādan wāḥidan wasīsatan wāḥida? nāqish dhālika maʿa zumalāʾik
dialogue.en: Do you think it is best for the world to have one economy and one politics? Discuss that with your classmates.
dialogue.ur: Kya aap samajhte hain ke duniya ke liye ek maeeshat aur ek siyasat behtar hai? Apne saathiyon se is par behes karein.

q.en: How do you ask «Do you agree?»
q.ar: أَيُّ سُؤالٍ يَطْلُبُ المُوافَقَةَ عَلى رَأْيٍ؟

title.en: Countries of the North and the South

intro.en: A reading passage that compares rich countries of the north with poor countries of the south. A man invites his friend to fly over the small village of the world and see how people live.
intro.ur: Is paaray mein shimali amir mumalik aur janubi ghareeb mumalik ka muqabla hai. Ek shakhs apne dost ko hawai jahaz par duniya ke chhote gaon ki sair par bulata hai taake dekhe log kaise rehte hain.
intro.ar: نَصٌّ يُقارِنُ بَيْنَ دُوَلِ الشَّمالِ الغَنِيَّةِ وَدُوَلِ الجَنوبِ الفَقيرَةِ. رَجُلٌ يَدْعو صَديقَهُ لِيَطيرا فَوْقَ قَرْيَةِ العالَمِ الصَّغيرَةِ وَيَرَيا كَيْفَ يَعيشُ النّاسُ.

dialogue.ar: جَلَسَ سَلْمانُ مَعَ أَبيهِ أَمامَ الكُرَةِ الأَرْضِيَّةِ، فَقالَ الأَبُ: العالَمُ اليَوْمَ كَقَرْيَةٍ صَغيرَةٍ، فَهَيّا نَتَخَيَّلُ أَنَّنا نَزورُها.
dialogue.tr: jalasa salmānu maʿa abīhi amāma l-kurati l-arḍiyya, faqāla l-ab al-ʿālamu l-yawma kaqaryatin ṣaghīra, fahayyā natakhayyalu annanā nazūruhā
dialogue.en: Salman sat with his father in front of the globe, and the father said: the world today is like a small village, so come, let us imagine that we are visiting it.
dialogue.ur: Salman apne walid ke saath globe ke saamne baitha, to walid ne kaha: aaj ki duniya ek chhote gaon ki tarah hai, aao tasawwur karein ke hum us ki sair karte hain.

dialogue.ar: رَكِبا في الخَيالِ طائِرَةً سَريعَةً، وَطارا إِلى شَمالِ الأَرْضِ.
dialogue.tr: rakibā fī l-khayli ṭāʾiratan sarīʿa, waṭārā ilā shamāli l-arḍ
dialogue.en: In imagination they boarded a fast plane and flew to the north of the earth.
dialogue.ur: Khayal hi khayal mein wo tez hawai jahaz mein sawar hue aur zameen ke shimal ki taraf ud gaye.

dialogue.ar: قالَ الأَبُ: اُنْظُرْ يا سَلْمانُ، هَذِهِ دُوَلٌ غَنِيَّةٌ، فيها القُوَّةُ وَالعِلْمُ وَالمالُ.
dialogue.tr: qāla l-ab unẓur yā salmān, hādhihi duwalun ghaniyya, fīhā l-quwwatu wal-ʿilmu wal-māl
dialogue.en: The father said: Look, Salman, these are rich countries that have power, knowledge and money.
dialogue.ur: Walid ne kaha: Salman dekho, ye amir mulk hain jin ke paas taqat, ilm aur maal hai.

dialogue.ar: النّاسُ هُناكَ أَصِحّاءُ، يَلْبَسونَ ثِياباً جَميلَةً وَيَعيشونَ في بُيوتٍ مُريحَةٍ.
dialogue.tr: an-nāsu hunāka aṣiḥḥāʾ, yalbasūna thīban jamīlatan wayaʿīshūna fī buywtin murīḥa
dialogue.en: The people there are healthy; they wear beautiful clothes and live in comfortable houses.
dialogue.ur: Wahan ke log tandurust hain, khoobsurat kapde pehente hain aur aaramdeh gharon mein rehte hain.

dialogue.ar: وَفي كُلِّ مَدينَةٍ مَصانِعُ وَمَزارِعُ وَمُسْتَشْفَياتٌ وَجامِعاتٌ كَثيرَةٌ، وَالنّاسُ يَعيشونَ في أَمْنٍ وَرَخاءٍ.
dialogue.tr: wafī kulli madīnatin maṣāniʿu wamazāriʿu wamustashfaytun wajāmiʿātun kathīra, wan-nāsu yaʿīshūna fī amnin warakhāʾ
dialogue.en: In every city there are many factories, farms, hospitals and universities, and people live in security and prosperity.
dialogue.ur: Har shehar mein bohat si factories, kheton, aspatalon aur jamiaat hain, aur log aman o khushhali mein rehte hain.

dialogue.ar: ثُمَّ طارَتِ الطّائِرَةُ إِلى جَنوبِ الأَرْضِ، فَرَأى سَلْمانُ دُوَلاً فَقيرَةً لا تَمْلِكُ ما تَمْلِكُهُ دُوَلُ الشَّمالِ.
dialogue.tr: thumma ṭārati ṭ-ṭāʾiratu ilā janūbi l-arḍ, faraʾā salmānu duwalan faqīratan lā tamliku mā tamlikuhu duwalu sh-shamāl
dialogue.en: Then the plane flew to the south of the earth, and Salman saw poor countries that do not have what the countries of the north have.
dialogue.ur: Phir jahaz zameen ke janub ki taraf ud gaya, to Salman ne ghareeb mulk dekhe jin ke paas wo nahin jo shimal ke mulkon ke paas hai.

dialogue.ar: هُناكَ يَلْبَسُ النّاسُ ثِياباً بَسيطَةً وَيَسْكُنونَ في بُيوتٍ صَغيرَةٍ، وَكَثيرٌ مِنْهُمْ مَرْضى.
dialogue.tr: hunāka yalbasu n-nāsu thīban basīṭatan wayaskunūna fī buywtin ṣaghīra, wakathīrun minhum marḍā
dialogue.en: There people wear simple clothes and live in small houses, and many of them are sick.
dialogue.ur: Wahan log saada kapde pehente hain aur chhote gharon mein rehte hain, aur un mein se bohat se bimar hain.

dialogue.ar: المَصانِعُ هُناكَ قَليلَةٌ، وَكَذَلِكَ المَدارِسُ وَالمُسْتَشْفَياتُ وَالمَزارِعُ، وَالحَرْبُ تُدَمِّرُ بَعْضَ البِلادِ.
dialogue.tr: al-maṣāniʿu hunāka qalīla, wakadhalika l-madārisu wal-mustashfaytu wal-mazāriʿ, wal-ḥarbu tudammiru baʿḍa l-bilād
dialogue.en: Factories there are few, and so are schools, hospitals and farms, and war destroys some of the lands.
dialogue.ur: Wahan factories kam hain, aur isi tarah school, aspatal aur khet bhi, aur jang kuch mulkon ko tabah kar rahi hai.

dialogue.ar: سَأَلَ سَلْمانُ: وَلِمَ يُصيبُ الفَقْرُ وَالجَهْلُ وَالمَرَضُ أُناساً كَثيرينَ هُناكَ يا أَبي؟
dialogue.tr: saʾala salmān walima yuṣību l-faqru wal-jahlu wal-maraḍu unāsan kathīrīna hunāka yā abī?
dialogue.en: Salman asked: And why do poverty, ignorance and sickness afflict so many people there, father?
dialogue.ur: Salman ne poochha: Abbu, wahan itne zyada logon ko ghurbat, jahalat aur bimari kyun lag jati hai?

dialogue.ar: قالَ الأَبُ: كَما تَرى يا بُنَيَّ، في هَذِهِ القَرْيَةِ الكَبيرَةِ فَريقٌ يَعيشُ في رَخاءٍ، وَفَريقٌ يَعيشُ في فَقْرٍ وَخَوْفٍ.
dialogue.tr: qāla l-ab kamā tarā yā bunayy, fī hādhihi l-qaryati l-kabīrati farīqun yaʿīshu fī rakhāʾ, wafarīqun yaʿīshu fī faqrin wakhawf
dialogue.en: The father said: As you see, my son, in this big village one group lives in prosperity and one group lives in poverty and fear.
dialogue.ur: Walid ne kaha: Beta, jaisa tum dekh rahe ho, is bade gaon mein ek giroh khushhali mein aur ek ghurbat aur khauf mein rehta hai.

dialogue.ar: قالَ سَلْمانُ: هَلْ سَيَتَغَيَّرُ هَذا يَوْماً ما؟ فَقالَ الأَبُ: اللهُ أَعْلَمُ.
dialogue.tr: qāla salmān hal sayataghayyaru hādhā yawman mā? faqāla l-ab allāh aʿlam
dialogue.en: Salman said: Will this change one day? The father said: Allah knows best.
dialogue.ur: Salman ne kaha: Kya ye kisi din badlega? Walid ne kaha: Allah behtar jaanta hai.

q.en: Which countries are rich in the passage?
q.ur: Paare mein kaun se mumalik amir hain?

q.en: What spreads in the countries of the south, according to the passage?
q.ur: Paare ke mutabiq janubi mumalik mein kya phailta hai?
q.ar: ماذا يَنْتَشِرُ في دُوَلِ الجَنوبِ حَسَبَ النَّصِّ؟

title.en: Grammar: the case of the present verb

intro.en: The present verb is raised (damma) by default. After a nasb particle such as «أَنْ» or «لَنْ» it takes fatha. After a jazm particle such as «لَمْ» or «لا» of prohibition it takes sukun. Example: «يَقْرَأُ» then «لَنْ يَقْرَأَ» then «لَمْ يَقْرَأْ».
intro.ur: Fe'l-e-mudari' asal mein marfoo' (damma) hota hai. «أَنْ» ya «لَنْ» jaise harf-e-nasb ke baad fatha aata hai. «لَمْ» ya «لا» (nahi) jaise harf-e-jazm ke baad sukoon aata hai. Misal: «يَقْرَأُ»، phir «لَنْ يَقْرَأَ»، phir «لَمْ يَقْرَأْ».
intro.ar: الفِعْلُ المُضارِعُ مَرْفوعٌ بِالضَّمَّةِ في الأَصْلِ. وَبَعْدَ أَداةِ نَصْبٍ مِثْلِ «أَنْ» وَ«لَنْ» يَأْخُذُ فَتْحَةً، وَبَعْدَ أَداةِ جَزْمٍ مِثْلِ «لَمْ» وَ«لا» النّاهِيَةِ يَأْخُذُ سُكوناً. مِثالٌ: يَقْرَأُ، لَنْ يَقْرَأَ، لَمْ يَقْرَأْ.

dialogue.ar: أُحِبُّ أَنْ أَقْرَأَ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ.
dialogue.tr: uḥibbu an aqraʾa kulla yawm
dialogue.en: I love to read every day. (after «an»: fatha)
dialogue.ur: Mujhe roz parhna pasand hai. («an» ke baad: fatha)

dialogue.ar: لَنْ يَصِلَ القِطارُ اليَوْمَ.
dialogue.tr: lan yaṣila l-qiṭāru l-yawm
dialogue.en: The train will not arrive today. (after «lan»: fatha)
dialogue.ur: Aaj train nahin pahunchegi. («lan» ke baad: fatha)

dialogue.ar: لَمْ يَكْتُبْ سَعيدٌ الرِّسالَةَ.
dialogue.tr: lam yaktub saʿīdun ar-risāla
dialogue.en: Saeed did not write the letter. (after «lam»: sukun)
dialogue.ur: Saeed ne khat nahin likha. («lam» ke baad: sukoon)

dialogue.ar: لا تَكْتُبْ عَلى الجِدارِ.
dialogue.tr: lā taktub ʿalā l-jidār
dialogue.en: Do not write on the wall. (after «lā» of prohibition: sukun)
dialogue.ur: Deewar par mat likho. («laa» nahi ke baad: sukoon)

dialogue.ar: يَفْتَحُ الوَلَدُ النّافِذَةَ.
dialogue.tr: yaftaḥu l-waladu n-nāfidha
dialogue.en: The boy opens the window. (no particle: damma)
dialogue.ur: Ladka khirki kholta hai. (koi harf nahin: damma)

dialogue.ar: تَسْمَعُ سَلْمى الأَخْبارَ.
dialogue.tr: tasmaʿu salmā l-akhbār
dialogue.en: Salma listens to the news. (no particle: damma)
dialogue.ur: Salma khabrein sunti hai. (koi harf nahin: damma)

dialogue.ar: لا تَلْعَبْ في الشّارِعِ يا بُنَيَّ.
dialogue.tr: lā talʿab fī sh-shāriʿi yā bunayy
dialogue.en: Do not play in the street, my son.
dialogue.ur: Beta, sarak par mat khelo.

dialogue.ar: لَنْ أَتَأَخَّرَ عَنِ المَدْرَسَةِ.
dialogue.tr: lan ataʾakhkhara ʿani l-madrasa
dialogue.en: I will never be late for school.
dialogue.ur: Main school se kabhi der nahin karunga.

dialogue.ar: أَرْجو أَنْ تَزورَنا غَداً.
dialogue.tr: arjū an tazūranā ghadan
dialogue.en: I hope you visit us tomorrow.
dialogue.ur: Umeed hai ke aap kal hamare ghar aayenge.

q.en: After «لَنْ» the present verb ends in:
After «لَمْ» the present verb ends in:

q.ur: «أُريدُ أَنْ أُسافِرَ» ko mana'ee shakl dein:

intro.en: Practise writing short paragraphs about what you learned: old and modern transport, communication, the difference between rich and poor countries, and the second dialogue as a story.
intro.ur: Jo kuch seekha usay chhote paragraph mein likhne ki mashq karein: purani aur jadeed sawariyan, rabta, amir aur ghareeb mumalik ka farq, aur doosri guftagu ko kahani ki shakl mein.
intro.ar: تَدَرَّبْ عَلى كِتابَةِ فَقَراتٍ قَصيرَةٍ عَمّا تَعَلَّمْتَ: النَّقْلُ قَديماً وَحَديثاً، وَالاتِّصالُ، وَالفَرْقُ بَيْنَ الدُّوَلِ الغَنِيَّةِ وَالفَقيرَةِ، وَالحِوارُ الثّاني عَلى شَكْلِ قِصَّةٍ.

options_ar: جُزْءٌ مِنْ نَصٍّ يَضُمُّ جُمَلاً مُتَرابِطَةً

intro.en: Practise the Ruq'a script, a simple and quick everyday handwriting. Notice which letters go below the line and which letters have an empty inside.
intro.ur: Khat-e-ruq'a ki mashq karein, jo roz-marra ki aasaan aur tez likhai hai. Dekhein kaun se harf line ke neeche jaate hain aur kin ke andar khali jagah hoti hai.
intro.ar: تَدَرَّبْ عَلى خَطِّ الرُّقْعَةِ، وَهُوَ خَطٌّ بَسيطٌ وَسَريعٌ لِلْكِتابَةِ اليَوْمِيَّةِ. اِنْتَبِهْ إِلى الحُروفِ الَّتي تَنْزِلُ تَحْتَ السَّطْرِ وَالحُروفِ المُجَوَّفَةِ.

q.en: What does «اُكْتُبْها» ask you to do?
